info.title: Maktaba API
info.summary: Self-hosted video library with automatic transcription, semantic search, and adaptive streaming.
info.description:
The Maktaba API is the control plane for a self-hosted video library. It exposes
libraries, videos, transcripts, search, processing jobs, streaming sessions, and
user state over a uniform JSON surface.

## Conventions

- **Transport.** HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 over TLS. JSON request and response bodies
  use `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`. Error responses use
  [RFC 9457](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457) `application/problem+json`.
- **Identifiers.** Resource ids are UUIDv4 unless documented otherwise.
  `Job.id` and `AudioTrack.id` are 64-bit integers.
- **Times.** All timestamps are RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 in UTC (`Z` suffix).
  Durations and offsets are seconds as floats.
- **Pagination.** Cursor-based. Pass `limit` (default 50, max 200) and the
  opaque `cursor` returned from the previous page. The page envelope is
  `{ items: [...], next: "<cursor>" | null }`. Cursors encode
  `(updated_at DESC, id DESC)` and rotate when the schema version changes.
- **Idempotency.** All `POST /api/jobs/{id}/{action}` endpoints are idempotent.
  Clients may set `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>` on `POST` and `PATCH` requests; the
  server replays the original response for 24 hours.
- **Request correlation.** Every response carries `X-Request-Id` (UUIDv7).
  Clients may pass their own `X-Request-Id` to thread it through.
- **Rate limits.** Default: 600 requests / minute / authenticated user, 6 000 /
  minute / IP. Exhausted requests get `429 Too Many Requests` with `Retry-After`
  and headers `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

## Authentication

Two equivalent paths backed by the same identity:

- **Web** uses `httpOnly` cookies set by `POST /api/auth/login`. State-changing
  requests must also include the `X-CSRF-Token` header (value mirrored from the
  `csrf_token` cookie).
- **Mobile / desktop / TV** uses bearer JWT (RS256, 15 min) with a long-lived
  opaque refresh token. Public keys are exposed at `/api/.well-known/jwks.json`.

Single-user installs may pass a static admin token via `Authorization: Bearer`.

## Streaming

The `/api/sessions` endpoints mint short-lived signed URLs that the client
sends to the Streaming Service (separate origin) directly. Bytes never round
trip the API.

## WebSocket

`GET /api/ws` upgrades to a multiplexed event stream. Messages are JSON
`{ type, data, at }` envelopes. Clients subscribe by sending
`{ type: "subscribe", channels: ["jobs", "playback", "library"] }` on connect.

post.summary: Authenticate with username and password
post.description:
On success, sets `auth` and `csrf_token` cookies (web) **and** returns a
bearer access token + refresh token in the body (mobile/TV). Clients use
whichever they need; the server issues both unconditionally.

post.summary: Create a new user account
post.description:
Disabled in single-user mode. When enabled, requires either an admin token
(multi-user with admin-only invites) or open registration if configured.

post.summary: Exchange a refresh token for a fresh access token
post.description:
Rotating refresh tokens; the previous refresh token is invalidated on use.
Web clients send the refresh token via the `refresh_token` cookie; native
clients send `{refresh_token}` in the body.

401.description: Refresh token invalid, revoked, or expired.

post.summary: Revoke current credentials
post.description: Clears auth cookies and revokes the bearer refresh token.

patch.description: Settings are deep-merged; pass `null` to clear a key.

parameters.description: Required when `purge=true`. Must equal the library id.

200.description: Playback state. Returns zeros if the user has not played the video yet.

put.summary: Upsert playback state for the current user and a video
put.description:
Server-side debounced (1 Hz per user/video). Fires `playback.completed`
on `false → true` transition. Excluded from per-user rate limits.

Maktaba-Warning.description: Set if `position_sec` was clamped to duration.

get.description:
Combines BM25 full-text and vector similarity using reciprocal rank fusion.
Results carry per-stage timing under `took_ms`. When semantic backend is
offline, the response sets `degraded=true` and falls back to FTS only.

503.description: Semantic backend unavailable and `mode=semantic` was requested.

post.summary: Hybrid search with a structured request body
post.description: Same semantics as `GET /search`; the body form is preferred when filters get long.

200.description: Up to 10 suggestions ranked by frequency.

post.description: Idempotent. With `?force=true`, flips state immediately and drops the in-flight segment.

409.description: Job is in a terminal state.

Returns a signed manifest URL (HLS / DASH) or direct URL. The client passes
it to its player; bytes are served by the Streaming Service, not the API.

Server-side debounced (1 Hz). Mirrors the position into `playback_state`.
Excluded from rate limits.

get.summary: Upgrade to the realtime event stream
get.description:
HTTP/1.1 upgrade to a WebSocket. Documented here for client-generation
tools that want to know the protocol exists; the message envelope is in
the schemas section as `WsMessage`.

### Channels
- `jobs` — job state and progress.
- `playback` — `playback.progress`, `playback.completed` events.
- `library` — `library.updated`, `videos.state_changed` events.
- `system` — `profiles_changed`, `health_changed`.

### Subscribe
```json
{ "type": "subscribe", "channels": ["jobs", "playback"] }
```

### Sample event
```json
{
  "type": "jobs.progress",
  "data": { "job_id": 42, "stage": "transcribe", "pct": 0.18, "eta_sec": 612 },
  "at": "2026-05-05T13:21:04Z"
}
```

Mounted at both `/health` (off the API root, for monitoring agents) and
`/api/system/health`. 503 if any required component is `down`.

503.description: At least one required component is down.

get.description:
Mounted at `/metrics` on a separate listener (default `127.0.0.1:9090`).
When `metrics_admin_token` is configured, requires `Authorization: Bearer`.

post.summary: Merge two speaker labels into one

bearerAuth.description:
RS256 access token (15 min). Mobile / desktop / TV clients pass it as
`Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The Streaming Service validates the same
JWT offline against the JWKS at `/.well-known/jwks.json`.

cookieAuth.name: auth
cookieAuth.description:
`httpOnly`, `secure`, `sameSite=lax` cookie set by `POST /auth/login`.
State-changing requests must also send the `X-CSRF-Token` header.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from the previous page's `next` field.

X-Request-Id.description: UUIDv7 correlation id. Echoed in every response.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix-epoch seconds when the window resets.

ValidationError.description: Request body or parameters failed validation.

Unavailable.description: A downstream dependency (Pipeline or Streaming) is unavailable.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.

instance.description: URI of the resource that produced the problem.

field.description: Dotted-path to the offending field, e.g. `roots[0]`.

next.description: Cursor for the next page; `null` on the last page.

refresh_token.description: Long-lived opaque token. Omitted for web clients (set via cookie).

partial.description: `true` when the window starts past the last segment\'s end.

url.description: Signed URL on the Streaming origin.

k.description: Fusion candidate-pool size for hybrid mode.

degraded.description: `true` when hybrid mode fell back to FTS only.

Settings.description: Effective settings (defaults ⊕ file ⊕ env ⊕ DB). Secrets redacted.

SettingsInput.description: Settings to persist to the DB layer.

push_token.description: Redacted in list / get responses; only echoed on register.

WsMessage.description:
Envelope for every server-to-client WebSocket message.
`type` follows the form `<channel>.<event>` (e.g. `jobs.progress`,
`playback.completed`, `library.updated`).

data.description: Event-specific payload. See per-event schemas below.

WsClientMessage.description: JSON envelope sent from client to server over the WebSocket. Use `subscribe` / `unsubscribe`.
